item.title: When Can You Count? Earliest Times, Eating Before & Friday Nights | Shulhan Arukh 489:2-6
item.description:
How early may the Omer be counted? Before plag it is meaningless, after sunset valid, after nightfall best. The class also covers answering at twilight when asked the night's count, the Rama's ban on eating before counting, and Friday nights.

item.title: Missed a Night of the Omer? Hadash, Bar Misvah & Omer Customs | Shulhan Arukh 489:7-10, 493:1-2
item.description:
Missed a night of the Omer? Count by day without a berakhah and carry on; miss a whole day and keep counting without one. Also covered: a boy who becomes bar misvah mid-Omer, converts, an onen, counting on Shabbat, hadash, weddings and haircuts.

item.title: Receiving The Torah: Laws, Minhagim & Customs - Halachot Of Shavuot
item.description:

item.title: 15: Daily Halacha: Having a Haircut on the Friday Before Lag BaOmer
item.description:
Can you have a haircut on the Friday before Lag BaOmer, which falls on Sunday this year? The Rema allows Ashkenazim to do so that Friday, in honour of Shabbat, but not on Saturday night. Sepharadim wait until the 34th day, Monday morning, and ask a rabbi if there is real need.
Daily Halacha — Sefirat HaOmer Dayan Daniel Kada
